theories.title: Complex scalar
theories.description: A complex scalar with a (φ̄φ)^k interaction, zero-dimensional: its Feynman graphs are plain graphs, matchings of φ with φ̄.

theories.title: Vector model
theories.description: A U(N)-invariant vector with (φ̄·φ)^k: each closed index line gives N; at large N the cactus graphs dominate and a gap equation sums them.

theories.title: Matrix model
theories.description: A complex N × N matrix with tr (MM†)^k: its Feynman graphs are ribbon graphs, surfaces of genus g weighted N^{2−2g}; the planar ones dominate, and at the critical coupling they become continuous 2D quantum gravity.

theories.title: Quartic melonic tensor model
theories.description: A tensor of rank d with the quartic melonic bubble of every colour: Feynman graphs are (d+1)-coloured graphs, pseudomanifolds weighted by their Gurau degree; the melonic ones dominate and resum into branched polymers.
theories.action: S[φ] = φ̄·φ + λ N^{1−d} Σ_c I_{melon,c}(φ, φ̄)

theories.title: Sextic wheel tensor model
theories.description: A rank-3 tensor with the wheel K₃,₃, a sextic bubble that is not melonic.

theories.title: Quartic necklace tensor model
theories.description: A rank-3 tensor with the quartic necklace.

theories.title: Coloured simplicial tensor model
theories.description: D + 1 tensors whose interaction is a D-simplex: every Feynman graph is a (D+1)-coloured graph and triangulates a D-dimensional pseudomanifold (Gurau 2011).
theories.action: S[φ] = Σ_c φ̄_c·φ_c + λ φ_0 ⋯ φ_D + λ̄ φ̄_0 ⋯ φ̄_D

theories.title: Boulatov's group field theory
theories.description: Fields on G³ with the gauge projection and the tetrahedral interaction: Feynman graphs are 4-coloured, their 2-complexes spin foams of three-dimensional gravity (Boulatov 1992); amplitudes here for a finite group.
theories.action: S[φ] = Σ_c ∫ φ̄_c P φ_c + λ ∫ φ_0 φ_1 φ_2 φ_3 + c.c.,  φ_c : G³ → ℂ

theories.title: Ooguri's group field theory
theories.description: Fields on G⁴ with the 4-simplex interaction: Feynman graphs are 5-coloured, their 2-complexes the spin foams of four-dimensional BF theory (Ooguri 1992); amplitudes for a finite group.
theories.action: S[φ] = Σ_c ∫ φ̄_c P φ_c + λ ∫ φ_0 ⋯ φ_4 + c.c.,  φ_c : G⁴ → ℂ

theories.title: Quartic melonic group field theory
theories.description: A tensorial group field theory: fields on G^d with the gauge projection and quartic melonic bubbles; its condensed phase is the setting of GFT cosmology.
theories.action: S[φ] = ∫ φ̄ P φ + λ Σ_c ∫ I_{melon,c}(φ, φ̄),  φ : G^d → ℂ
